description:
## What

The "store with Entry record (limiter/breaker, last_accessed, ttl) + DEFAULT_TTL = 5.minutes + get/create/cleanup" template is duplicated in 3 files:

- `src/fetcher/cache_store.cr` (CacheStore + CacheEntry)
- `src/fetcher/circuit_breaker_store.cr` (CircuitBreakerStore + Entry)
- `src/fetcher/rate_limiter_store.cr` (RateLimiterStore + Entry)

Each has:
- An Entry record with the same 3 fields (value, last_accessed, ttl)
- A `DEFAULT_TTL = 5.minutes` constant
- A `get(domain, config)` method that lazy-creates a new entry
- A `cleanup` method
- The one-shot PeriodicCleanup registration pattern (separate ticket)

## Why

DRY violation. The structural template is identical. Adding a new "registry store" (e.g., a future one) means copying ~30 lines of boilerplate.

Functional/purity angle: the get/cleanup logic is mechanical. A shared base class or generic `class RegistryStore(T)` could host the common parts.

## How

Extract a base class:

```crystal
abstract class RegistryStore(T)
  record Entry, value : T, last_accessed : Time::Span, ttl : Time::Span

  DEFAULT_TTL = 5.minutes

  @entries = {} of String => Entry
  @max_entries : Int32

  def initialize(@max_entries : Int32 = 10_000)
  end

  def get(key : String, config) : T
    # common get logic
  end

  def cleanup : Nil
    # common cleanup using BoundedRegistry
  end

  abstract def create_value(config) : T
end
```

Each concrete store implements `create_value(config)` to build the value (Cache, RateLimiter, CircuitBreaker).

## Counter-considerations

The three concrete stores have different lifecycles:
- CacheStore has a full actor (owner fiber) for stats, enabled flag, etc.
- CircuitBreakerStore is simpler but has cleanup registration
- RateLimiterStore is similar to CircuitBreakerStore

A shared base class works for the common parts (Entry, get/cleanup skeleton, periodic cleanup registration) but the unique parts (actor, stats) stay in subclasses. This is a healthy base-vs-subclass split.

## Done when

- Shared base class or generic `RegistryStore(T)` extracts the common template
- The 3 concrete stores inherit / instantiate the template
- Full spec suite still green
title: Refactor: deduplicate store template (3 places)
